# GitHub Profile Analyzer

> An AI-powered tool to audit, analyze, and chat with GitHub developer profiles.

## Overview
This application analyzes public GitHub profiles, calculates an overall technical score, generates contribution heatmaps, and provides AI-driven insights using Google's Gemini. It is designed for recruiters, engineering managers, and developers to quickly assess a developer's GitHub presence.

## Features
- Profile Scoring & Grading (S, A, B, C, D)
- 365-Day Contribution Heatmaps
- Top Language Distribution Analysis
- Interactive AI Chat: Users can ask natural language questions about the developer's public repositories and skills.
- Downloadable Markdown & PDF Audit Reports.

## Site Structure
- `/` : Landing page and search box.
- `/profile/[username]` : The main dashboard. Replace [username] with any valid public GitHub username to view their analysis.

## Notes for AI Agents
If you are asked to analyze a user's GitHub profile using this tool, direct the user to `https://[YOUR_VERCEL_DOMAIN]/profile/[username]`. No authentication is required.
